words.en: If you describe someone or something as exemplary, you think they are extremely good and suitable to be copied by other people.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: He is a paragon of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他是诚实的典范。
words.en: A paragon is someone who is considered to be a perfect example of a particular quality.

words.tr: n. 拟人化；人格化；化身；典型
words.ex: The statue is a personification of freedom.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像是自由的化身。
words.en: The act of attributing human characteristics to something nonhuman, or the representation of an abstract quality in human form.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: She is the quintessence of grace.
words.ex_cn: 她是优雅的典范。
words.en: The quintessence of something is the most perfect or typical example of it.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.ex: He received the sacrament on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日领受了圣礼。
words.en: A sacrament is a Christian religious ceremony or ritual regarded as imparting divine grace, such as baptism, the Eucharist, and (in the Roman Catholic and many Orthodox Churches) penance and anointing of the sick.

words.tr: adj. 非典型的；不规则的
words.ex: He has an atypical way of solving problems.
words.ex_cn: 他解决问题的方式很不寻常。
words.en: Not representative of a type, group, or class; unusual or irregular.

words.tr: n. 拨用；拨款；挪用；占有
words.ex: The government made an appropriation for education.
words.ex_cn: 政府为教育拨款。
words.en: The act of setting something aside for a specific purpose, especially funds.

words.tr: adj. 专卖的；专利的；所有权的
words.ex: The company uses proprietary software to protect its data.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用专有软件来保护其数据。
words.en: Relating to an owner or ownership; exclusive rights of possession, use, or control.

words.tr: adj. 保险统计师的；保险精算的
words.ex: He is learning actuarial science to work in insurance.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习精算科学，以便从事保险工作。
words.en: Actuarial work involves the use of statistical methods to assess risk in insurance and finance industries.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The old painting was sold at an auction.
words.ex_cn: 那幅旧画在拍卖会上被卖出了。
words.en: An auction is a public sale where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr: n. 物物交换；实物交易；
words.ex: They used barter to trade apples for eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他们用物物交换的方式用苹果换鸡蛋。
words.en: To trade goods or services without using money.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: He bought gold bullion as an investment.
words.ex_cn: 他购买了金条作为投资。
words.en: Gold or silver in bulk before coining, or valued by weight.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.tr: v. 应付；“deal”的现在分词； n. 交易；
words.ex: He is dealing with a difficult boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付一个难搞的老板。
words.en: Dealing refers to the way in which someone behaves towards other people or the way in which someone does business.

words.ex: The default setting is on.
words.ex_cn: 默认设置是开启的。
words.en: If a person, company, or country defaults on something that they have legally agreed to do, such as paying a debt or keeping to an agreement, they fail to do it.

words.ex: The company agreed to defray the travel expenses.
words.ex_cn: 公司同意支付差旅费。
words.en: If you defray someone's costs or expenses, you give them money which represents the amount that they have spent, for example while they have been doing something for you or acting on your behalf.

words.ex: The bank will disburse the loan next week.
words.ex_cn: 银行将在下周发放贷款。
words.en: To disburse means to pay out money from a fund or account.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: The government's exchequer has been boosted by recent tax reforms.
words.ex_cn: 政府的财库因最近的税制改革而得到增强。
words.en: The Exchequer is the account at the Bank of England in which is held the Consolidated Fund, out of which most government payments are made.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；无偿的
adv. 免费地；无偿地
words.ex: You can download the software gratis from the company's website.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从公司网站免费下载该软件。
words.en: If something is done or given gratis, it is done or given without payment.

words.ex: The store made an inventory of all the products.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有商品做了一份清单。
words.en: An inventory is a detailed list of all the items in a place.

words.tr:
n. 发票；发货单；
v. 开发票；记清单；
words.ex: He paid the bill after receiving the invoice.
words.ex_cn: 他收到发票后付了款。
words.en: An invoice is a document that lists goods or services that have been provided and says how much money you owe for them.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: He runs a mercantile shop in the old town.
words.ex_cn: 他在老城区经营一家商业店铺。
words.en: relating to trade or commerce; commercial.

words.tr: v. 兜售；沿街叫卖； 散播
words.ex: He tries to peddle fake watches on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在街上兜售假手表。
words.en: To peddle goods or ideas means to try to sell them or make them accepted by going from place to place.

words.tr:
n. 抽奖售物
v. 抽奖赠送（货品）
words.ex: He bought a ticket for the raffle.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张抽奖票。
words.en: A raffle is a type of lottery in which people buy tickets for a chance to win a prize.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；退款
v. 减少
words.ex: He got a rebate on his new TV.
words.ex_cn: 他买新电视时得到了一笔回扣。
words.en: A rebate is a partial refund to someone who has paid too much for tax, rent, or a utility.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: n. 往复运动；交互；互换
words.ex: The reciprocation of kindness is a fundamental aspect of human interaction.
words.ex_cn: 善意的交换是人际交往的基本方面。
words.en: The act of giving or doing something in return for something received.

words.tr: adj. 有报酬的；有利益的；
words.ex: He took a remunerative job to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他找了一份有报酬的工作来养家。
words.en: providing payment; profitable

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.tr: abbr. 货已收到；凭单（Receipt Of Goods）
words.ex: ROG: goods received.
words.ex_cn: 货已收到。
words.en: A rog is a person who behaves in a dishonest or criminal way.

words.ex: He bought some securities to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一些证券来存钱。
words.en: Securities are financial instruments that represent an ownership position in a publicly-traded corporation (stock), a creditor relationship with governmental body or a corporation (bond), or rights to ownership as represented by an option.

words.tr: v. 教唆；收买；贿赂某人作伪证
words.ex: He tried to suborn a witness with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱收买证人。
words.en: To induce someone to commit an unlawful or wrongful act, especially to give false testimony in court.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr: v. 承担经济责任；承保；承销
words.ex: The bank will underwrite the new project.
words.ex_cn: 银行将为这个新项目提供担保。
words.en: To agree to pay for a possible loss or damage, especially in insurance; to agree to buy all the shares that are not bought by the public in a new company, or to arrange for this to be done.

words.ex: He paid high usury on his loan.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了高额的高利贷。
words.en: The practice of lending money at an exorbitant interest rate.

words.ex: The barterer exchanged goods without the use of money.
words.ex_cn: 交易商在没有使用金钱的情况下交换了商品。
words.en: A barterer is someone who exchanges goods or services for other goods or services without using money.

words.ex: The government imposed a capitation tax to fund public services.
words.ex_cn: 政府征收人头税以资助公共服务。
words.en: A capitation is a tax or fee that is imposed on each individual in a population, regardless of income or resources.

words.ex: He receives a small emolument for his part-time job.
words.ex_cn: 他因兼职工作获得少量报酬。
words.en: A payment made to someone for work or services, typically in the form of a salary or fee.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: adj. 可下定义的；可确定的；可限定的
words.ex: The concept is definable within certain parameters.
words.ex_cn: 这个概念在某些参数内是可以定义的。
words.en: If something is definable, it can be described or explained clearly.

words.ex: The government made a fiscal decision to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 政府做出了降低税收的财政决定。
words.en: Fiscal is used to describe something that relates to government money or public money, especially taxes.

words.tr: n. 小费；赏钱；退职金；退伍金
words.ex: She left a small gratuity on the table for the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌上给服务员留下了一点小费。
words.en: A gratuity is a sum of money given to someone, typically to a service worker, in addition to the payment due for the service provided.

words.ex: He received an honorarium for his work as a guest speaker.
words.ex_cn: 他作为特邀演讲者得到了一笔酬金。
words.en: An honorarium is a payment given for professional services that are rendered nominally without charge.

words.ex: He writes all the money in the ledger.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都记在账本上。
words.en: A ledger is a book or collection of accounts in which account transactions are recorded.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.ex: He was solely motivated by the prospect of lucre.
words.ex_cn: 他唯一被钱财的前景所驱动。
words.en: Money, especially when regarded as sordid or distasteful or gained in a dishonorable way.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: He lost his pecuniary support after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了经济支持。
words.en: Pecuniary means relating to money, especially in terms of financial gain or loss.

words.ex: He was corrupted by the lure of pelf.
words.ex_cn: 他被钱财的诱惑所腐蚀。
words.en: Wealth or money, especially when regarded with contempt or as having been acquired in a dishonorable way.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.tr: n. 额外费用；保险费；溢价；
words.ex: You need to pay a premium for faster delivery.
words.ex_cn: 你需要支付额外费用才能享受更快的配送。
words.en: A premium is an amount of money that you pay regularly to an insurance company for an insurance policy, or an amount of money that is more than usual for a product or service because it is of higher quality.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He sent a remittance to his family last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周给家人汇了一笔款。
words.en: A remittance is a sum of money that you send to someone.

words.ex: The royalty lived in a large palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇族住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royalty refers to people of royal blood or status, or a sum of money paid to an author, composer, etc., for each copy of a work sold or for each public performance of their work.

words.ex: He received fair remuneration for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因工作获得了公平的报酬。
words.en: Remuneration refers to the money that is paid to someone for the work that they have done.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: The government provides a subvention to support the arts.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供补助金以支持艺术。
words.en: A subvention is a grant of money, especially from a government, to support an organization or activity.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.tr:
n. 什一税
v. 缴什一税
words.ex: The church required the peasants to pay tithes from their crops.
words.ex_cn: 教堂要求农民从他们的收成中缴纳什一税。
words.en: A tithe is a one-tenth part of something, paid as a contribution to a religious organization or compulsory tax to the government.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr: n. 年金；养老金；年金保险
words.ex: He receives an annuity every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月领取一笔年金。
words.en: An annuity is a fixed sum of money paid to someone each year, typically for the rest of their life.

words.ex: He pays alimony to his ex-wife every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付赡养费给前妻。
words.en: Alimony is an allowance made to one spouse by the other for support pending or after legal separation or divorce.

words.tr: n. 拖欠的款项；“arrear”的复数；
words.ex: He paid all his arrears last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周付清了所有拖欠的款项。
words.en: If someone is in arrears with their payments, or if their payments are in arrears, they have not paid the regular amounts of money that they should have paid.

words.ex: He loves the bucolic life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢乡村的田园生活。
words.en: Relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life.

words.tr:
n. 周边地区；附近
v. 包围；环绕；“environ”的第三人称单数
words.ex: The city's environs are filled with charming villages.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的郊区充满了迷人的村庄。
words.en: The area surrounding a place; the outskirts.

words.tr: n. 田园风景；田园生活；田园诗
words.ex: The small village was the perfect setting for an idyll.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄是田园诗的完美背景。
words.en: An idyll is a short poem or piece of prose that describes a peaceful or romantic scene, especially of rural life.

words.ex: The park was a familiar purlieu for the local residents.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是当地居民常去的地方。
words.en: The area near or surrounding a place.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.tr:
adj. 森林的
n. 森林中的人或物
words.ex: The sylvan path was quiet and green.
words.ex_cn: 这条林间小路安静而翠绿。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of woods or forest regions.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr:
n. 协约；契约
v. 订立契约
words.ex: They made a covenant to always help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们立下契约，永远互相帮助。
words.en: A covenant is a formal agreement or promise between two or more people, often involving legal obligations.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: He signed an indenture to work for five years.
words.ex_cn: 他签署了一份契约，同意工作五年。
words.en: An indenture is a formal legal agreement, contract, or document, such as a bond or a deed, especially one that specifies the terms of a debt or obligation.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.tr: n. 防卫手段；土地所有权凭证
words.ex: He carefully preserved the ancient muniments in the family archive.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地保存了家族档案中的古老契据。
words.en: A muniment is a document or record that serves as evidence or proof of a right or title, especially in legal contexts.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.ex: They made a concerted effort to clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们共同努力清理了公园。
words.en: A concerted action or effort is done by several people or groups working together.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: v. 委托；交付；托运；寄售
words.ex: He will consign the package to the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他将把包裹寄到邮局。
words.en: If you consign something to someone, you give it to them to keep or to sell.

words.ex: She entrusted her keys to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙托付给了朋友。
words.en: If you entrust something important to someone or entrust them with it, you give them the responsibility of looking after it or dealing with it.

words.tr: n. 会合地点；约会；集会
words.ex: They will rendezvous at the park at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在晚上6点在公园会合。
words.en: A rendezvous is a meeting that has been arranged between people, often secretly.

words.ex: He gave his troth to her in a traditional ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个传统仪式上向她许下了诺言。
words.en: Faithfulness, fidelity, or loyalty, especially in a pledge or promise; also, a betrothal.

words.tr: n. 约会；幽会；幽会地点
words.ex: They met at a secret tryst in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们在树林里一个秘密的地方相会。
words.en: A tryst is a secret meeting between lovers.

words.tr: n. 沙文主义；盲目的爱国心
words.ex: He shows chauvinism by thinking men are better than women.
words.ex_cn: 他认为男人比女人更好，表现出大男子主义。
words.en: Chauvinism is the strong and unreasonable belief that your own country or race is the best or most important.

words.tr: adj. 沙文主义的；盲目爱国的；大男人主义的
words.ex: His chauvinistic remarks about the superiority of his own country were met with disapproval.
words.ex_cn: 他关于自己国家优越性的沙文主义言论遭到了反对。
words.en: If you describe someone as chauvinistic, you believe that they think their own country or sex is better than any other.

words.tr: n. 世界大同主义；四海一家
words.ex: He loves cosmopolitanism because he enjoys meeting people from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱世界主义，因为他喜欢结识来自许多国家的人。
words.en: The ideology that all human ethnic groups belong to a single community based on a shared morality.

words.tr: n. 教条主义；武断；独断论
words.ex: His dogmatism makes it hard to talk with him.
words.ex_cn: 他的教条主义让他很难交流。
words.en: Dogmatism is the tendency to lay down principles as undeniably true, without consideration of evidence or the opinions of others.

words.ex: He is a dogmatist who never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 他是个从不听别人意见的教条主义者。
words.en: A dogmatist is someone who asserts their opinions in an arrogant manner, without considering the opinions of others.

words.ex: He likes eclecticism in music, from jazz to rock.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐上的折衷主义，从爵士到摇滚。
words.en: Eclecticism is a conceptual approach that does not hold rigidly to a single paradigm or set of assumptions, but instead draws upon multiple theories, styles, or ideas to gain complementary insights into a subject, or applies different theories in particular cases.

words.tr: n. 自我主义；利己主义
words.ex: He acts out of egoism, not kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他出于利己主义行事，而不是善意。
words.en: Egoism is the belief that you should think about your own interests and needs rather than those of other people.

words.ex: He believes in empiricism and trusts what he can see.
words.ex_cn: 他相信经验主义，只相信自己能看见的东西。
words.en: The practice of relying on observation and experiment especially in the natural sciences.

words.tr:
adj. 享乐的；吃喝玩乐的 
n. 享乐主义者；美食家
words.ex: He is an epicurean who loves good food and wine.
words.ex_cn: 他是个享乐主义者，喜欢美食和美酒。
words.en: Epicurean refers to someone who is devoted to sensual enjoyment, especially that derived from fine food and drink.

words.ex: His poem explores existential questions about life.
words.ex_cn: 他的诗歌探讨了有关存在的生命问题。
words.en: Relating to existence, especially human existence as viewed in the theories of existentialism.

words.ex: He lives by hedonism, seeking pleasure every day.
words.ex_cn: 他奉行享乐主义，每天追求快乐。
words.en: Hedonism is the belief that gaining pleasure is the most important thing in life.

words.tr: n. 沙文主义；侵略主义
words.ex: He shouted with jingoism during the national parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在国庆游行中带着沙文主义大喊大叫。
words.en: Jingoism is an extreme form of patriotism that often involves a belligerent foreign policy, advocating the use of threats or actual force against other countries in order to safeguard what it perceives as its country's national interests.

words.ex: He is interested in metaphysics and asks big questions about life.
words.ex_cn: 他对形而上学感兴趣，会思考关于生命的重大问题。
words.en: Metaphysics is a branch of philosophy that deals with the first principles of things, including abstract concepts such as being, knowing, substance, cause, identity, time, and space.

words.ex: He believes in nihilism and thinks nothing matters.
words.ex_cn: 他相信虚无主义，认为什么都不重要。
words.en: Nihilism is the belief that all values are baseless and that nothing can be known or communicated.

words.tr: n. 爱国主义；爱国精神；
words.ex: He showed patriotism by serving his country in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在军队中为国家服务表现出爱国主义。
words.en: Patriotism is the love and devotion to one's country.

words.ex: His pessimism made him expect the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲观主义让他总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: Pessimism is the belief that bad things are going to happen or that something is going to turn out badly.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: The painting shows surrealism with floating clocks.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画用漂浮的钟表表现超现实主义。
words.en: A 20th-century avant-garde movement in art and literature which sought to release the creative potential of the unconscious mind, for example by the irrational juxtaposition of images.

words.ex: He supports radicalism to change the system.
words.ex_cn: 他支持激进主义来改变制度。
words.en: Radicalism is the belief or behavior of people who advocate thorough or complete political or social reform.

words.ex: Friendship needs reciprocity to last.
words.ex_cn: 友谊需要相互性才能持久。
words.en: A situation in which two people, countries, etc. help each other or behave in the same way to each other.

words.ex: He is a revisionist historian who questions old stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位修正主义历史学家，质疑旧的故事。
words.en: A revisionist is someone who advocates or practices revision, especially of a political or historical nature, often challenging the accepted views or interpretations.

words.tr:
adj. 极权主义的
n. 极权主义者
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A totalitarian political system is one in which there is only one political party which controls everything and does not allow any opposition parties.

words.ex: He supports conservatism because he likes traditional values.
words.ex_cn: 他支持保守主义，因为他喜欢传统价值观。
words.en: Conservatism is a political and social philosophy promoting traditional social institutions in the context of culture and civilization.

words.tr: n.  沙文主义者；侵略主义者
words.ex: He was criticized for his jingoist views on foreign policy.
words.ex_cn: 他因在外交政策上的沙文主义观点而受到批评。
words.en: A jingoist is someone who believes that their own country is always best and who is in favor of aggressive or warlike policies towards other countries.

words.tr: adj. 和平主义的；和平的
words.ex: His irenic tone helped calm the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他平和的语气帮助平息了争论。
words.en: Promoting peace; conciliatory.

words.tr:
adj. 沙文主义的；本着…第一主义者
n. 沙文主义者；盲目的爱国者
words.ex: He is a chauvinist who thinks men are better than women.
words.ex_cn: 他是个沙文主义者，认为男人比女人优秀。
words.en: A chauvinist is a person who believes in the superiority of their own group, especially their own gender or nationality, often to the point of being prejudiced against other groups.

words.ex: He believes in fatalism and does not try to change his fate.
words.ex_cn: 他相信宿命论，不愿改变自己的命运。
words.en: Fatalism is the belief that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.

words.tr: adj. 典范的；典型的；标准的
words.ex: The book uses a canonical example to explain the rule.
words.ex_cn: 这本书使用一个标准例子来解释这个规则。
words.en: According to, ordered by, or conforming to a church canon or canons.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: The government decided to codify the old laws.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定将旧法律编纂成典。
words.en: To codify means to arrange laws, rules, etc. into a systematic code.

words.ex: Doctors must follow medical ethics.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须遵守医学道德规范。
words.en: Ethics are moral beliefs and rules about right and wrong.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.ex: His creed is to always tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的信条是永远说真话。
words.en: A creed is a set of beliefs, principles, or opinions that strongly influence the way people live or work.

words.ex: The lawyer was disbarred for lying in court.
words.ex_cn: 这名律师因在法庭上撒谎而被吊销执照。
words.en: To expel a lawyer from the bar, thereby depriving them of the right to practice law.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: v. 考试不及格；给不及格分数
words.ex: He flunked math last semester.
words.ex_cn: 他上学期数学没及格。
words.en: If you flunk an exam or a course, you fail to reach the required standard.

words.tr: adj. 不合格的；不符合资格的
words.ex: He is ineligible to vote because he is under 18.
words.ex_cn: 他因为未满18岁而没有资格投票。
words.en: If someone is ineligible for something, they are not allowed to have it or do it because they have broken a rule or do not reach the standard that is needed.

words.ex: The roof is made of slate.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶是由板岩制成的。
words.en: A slate is a fine-grained, foliated, homogeneous metamorphic rock derived from an original shale-type sedimentary rock composed of clay or volcanic ash through low-grade regional metamorphism. It is the finest grained foliated metamorphic rock. Foliation may not correspond to the original sedimentary layering, but instead is in planes perpendicular to the direction of metamorphic compression.

words.tr:
adj. 主教管区的
n. 教区主教
words.ex: The diocesan priest helps people in the local church.
words.ex_cn: 教区神父帮助当地教堂的人们。
words.en: Relating to a diocese, which is the district under the pastoral care of a bishop in the Christian Church.

words.tr: n. （教堂中的）诵经台；（演讲的）讲台；斜面高腿小桌
words.ex: The professor stood behind the lectern to deliver his speech.
words.ex_cn: 教授站在讲台后面发表演讲。
words.en: A lectern is a tall desk with a sloping top from which someone, typically a speaker or lecturer, can read while standing up.

words.tr: v. 使改变宗教（或政治）信仰
words.ex: He tries to proselytize his friends about his new religion.
words.ex_cn: 他试图让他的朋友信奉他的新宗教。
words.en: To proselytize means to try to persuade someone to change their religious or political beliefs or way of living to your own.

words.tr: v. 赋予新肉体；（使）转生
words.ex: He believes he will reincarnate as a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己会转世成一只鸟。
words.en: To be born again in another body or form after death.

words.ex: His impiety shocked the religious community.
words.ex_cn: 他的不敬震惊了宗教界。
words.en: Lack of piety or reverence, especially toward a god.

words.ex: He challenges the orthodoxy of traditional teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他挑战传统教学的正统观念。
words.en: Orthodoxy refers to the quality of conforming to established doctrines or practices, especially in religion.

words.ex: The seraph floated above the altar in the dream.
words.ex_cn: 在梦中，炽天使在祭坛上方飘浮。
words.en: In Christian theology, a seraph is a type of celestial or heavenly being in the highest order of the ninefold celestial hierarchy, associated with light, ardor, and purity.

words.tr: adj. 极神圣的；神圣不可侵犯的
words.ex: The church's rules were considered sacrosanct and unchangeable.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的规定被认为是神圣不可侵犯的，不可改变的。
words.en: If you describe something as sacrosanct, you mean that it is considered to be special and should not be changed or interfered with.

words.tr: n. （学校、医院、军队、监狱中的）牧师；
words.ex: The chaplain prayed with the soldiers before the mission.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在任务前为士兵们祈祷。
words.en: A chaplain is a member of the clergy attached to a private chapel, institution, ship, regiment, etc.

words.tr:
n. 传教士；牧师；神职人员
adj. 神职者的；牧师的；教会的
words.ex: The ecclesiastic spoke about faith in church.
words.ex_cn: 这位神职人员在教堂里谈论信仰。
words.en: An ecclesiastic is a priest or minister in the Christian Church.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 避难所

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 柄

words.tr:
n. 柄
v. 装上柄
words.ex: He held the axe by the haft.
words.ex_cn: 他用手柄握着斧头。
words.en: The handle of a knife, axe, or other tool or weapon.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.ex: He broke the helve of the axe.
words.ex_cn: 他把斧头的柄弄断了。
words.en: The handle of a tool or weapon, especially that of an axe or a hammer.

words.ex: He grabbed the hilt of his sword.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住了剑柄。
words.en: The hilt of a sword or dagger is the handle, especially the part by which it is held.

words.ex: The pitcher threw the ball fast.
words.ex_cn: 投掷的人把球投得很快。
words.en: A pitcher is a player in baseball who throws the ball to the batter. It can also refer to a large container with a handle and a lip, used for holding and pouring liquids.

words.tr:
adj.. 手下不留情的
vt. 用大锤猛打
n. 长柄大锤；猛烈的锤击
words.ex: He hit the nail with a sledgehammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用大锤敲了钉子。
words.en: A sledgehammer is a large, heavy hammer with a long handle, used for breaking up rocks and concrete.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 储藏室

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.tr: n. 土窖；地穴；教堂地下室
words.ex: He found a crypt under the old church.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧教堂下面发现了一个地窖。
words.en: A crypt is a room or chamber beneath a church, used as a burial place.

words.tr:
n. 贮藏物；隐藏物
v. 贮藏；囤积
words.ex: The treasure hunter found a hoard of gold coins.
words.ex_cn: 寻宝者发现了一堆金币。
words.en: If you hoard things such as food or money, you save or store them, often in secret, because they are valuable or important to you.

words.ex: The bank keeps money in a vault.
words.ex_cn: 银行把钱存放在金库里。
words.en: A vault is an arched structure that forms a ceiling or roof, or a room, especially in a church, that has an arched ceiling or roof. It can also refer to a jump over something using your hands or a pole to push yourself off the ground.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 船相关

words.ex: The sailboat's mast is very tall.
words.ex_cn: 帆船的船桅很高。
words.en: A mast is a tall pole on a ship or boat that supports the sails.

words.tr: n. （船上用作信号等的）三角旗；（奖给棒球等联赛优胜队的）锦旗
words.ex: The ship flew a red pennant to signal danger.
words.ex_cn: 那艘船升起一面红色三角旗来警示危险。
words.en: A pennant is a long, narrow, triangular flag that is used as a symbol, especially by ships and sports teams.

words.tr:
n. 舷窗；天窗；气窗；煤斗；煤箱
v. 碎步疾跑；急忙撤退；（故意）破坏；凿沉（船）
words.ex: The sailor cleaned the scuttle to let in more light.
words.ex_cn: 水手清洁了舷窗，以便让更多的光线照进来。
words.en: To scuttle means to run hurriedly or furtively with short quick steps. It can also refer to a small opening in a ship's deck or hull, or a container for coal.

words.tr: n. 小艇；小型帆船；小船
words.ex: They rowed the skiff across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们划着小艇穿过湖面。
words.en: A skiff is a small, light boat for rowing or sailing, typically for one person.

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.ex: The tugboat pulls a big ship into the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 拖船把一艘大船拉进港口。
words.en: A tugboat is a small, powerful boat designed to pull or push larger ships in harbors, through canals, or in the open sea.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 服饰

words.ex: She bought new apparel for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing, especially outer garments; attire.

words.ex: He wore formal attire to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了正式服装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothes, especially fine or formal ones.

words.tr: n. 软帽；汽车发动机罩；阀帽
words.ex: The girl wore a white bonnet to the church.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩戴着一顶白色软帽去教堂。
words.en: A bonnet is a type of hat that is tied under the chin and was traditionally worn by women and girls. It can also refer to the metal cover over the engine of a car.

words.ex: She wears a silver bracelet every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天戴一条银手链。
words.en: A bracelet is a piece of jewellery that you wear around your wrist or arm.

words.ex: She wore a silver brooch on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一枚银色胸针别在外套上。
words.en: A brooch is a piece of jewelry that has a pin at the back so it can be fastened to a dress, blouse, or coat.

words.ex: He fixed his collar before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前整理了衣领。
words.en: The part of a piece of clothing that fits around the neck and is usually folded over; a band of material around the neck of an animal.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.ex: He wears a red cravat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一条红色领结去参加派对。
words.en: A cravat is a piece of folded cloth which a man wears wrapped around his neck.

words.tr:
n. 袖口；裤子翻边；巴掌；手铐
v. 给...上袖口（或翻边）；用手掌轻拍；用巴掌打
words.ex: He rolled up his cuff to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖口来洗手。
words.en: The part at the end of a sleeve, where the material of the sleeve is turned back or a separate band is sewn on. Also, to fasten someone's hands together with a pair of handcuffs.

words.tr: n. 粗斜纹棉布；劳动布；牛仔布
words.ex: He wears blue denim jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Denim is a kind of cotton fabric, typically blue, used for making jeans, jackets, and other clothing.

words.ex: He doffed his hat as a sign of respect.
words.ex_cn: 他脱帽以示敬意。
words.en: To remove an item of clothing, especially a hat.

words.ex: He wears a uniform with gold epaulets.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着带有金色肩章的制服。
words.en: An epaulet is a decorative piece of material that is worn on the shoulders of a uniform, especially by military officers, to show their rank.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The doctor examined the fascia around the muscle.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了肌肉周围的筋膜。
words.en: A fascia is a band or sheet of connective tissue, primarily collagen, beneath the skin that attaches, stabilizes, encloses, and separates muscles and other internal organs.

words.ex: She wore finery to the royal ball.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着华丽的服装去参加皇家舞会。
words.en: Finery refers to elaborate or showy attire and decorations.

words.ex: He wears a flannel shirt in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿法兰绒衬衫。
words.en: Flannel is a soft woven fabric, typically made of wool or cotton and slightly napped on one or both sides.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.tr:
n. 紧身褡；腰带；围绕物
v. 以腰带束缚；围绕
words.ex: She wore a girdle to look slimmer.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条束腰裙来显得更苗条。
words.en: A girdle is a piece of women's underwear that fits tightly around the stomach, hips, and bottom.

words.ex: He wore the school insignia on his jacket.
words.ex_cn: 他把学校的徽章戴在夹克上。
words.en: An insignia is a badge or a sign that shows someone's rank, membership, or achievements.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: She washed the linen in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 她用冷水洗亚麻布。
words.en: Linen is a kind of cloth that is made from the fibers of the flax plant. It is used to make clothes, sheets, and tablecloths.

words.ex: He found a lint on his black jacket.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的黑色夹克上发现了一根绒毛。
words.en: Lint is small fibers or fluffs of cotton or wool that come off clothes or other materials.

words.tr: n. 派克大衣；皮制大衣；风雪外套
words.ex: He wears a parka in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿派克大衣。
words.en: A parka is a type of coat with a hood, often lined with fur or faux fur, designed to protect the wearer from cold weather.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.tr:
n. 长袍
v. （使）穿上长袍
words.ex: He puts on a white robe after the shower.
words.ex_cn: 他洗完澡后穿上一件白袍。
words.en: A robe is a long, loose piece of clothing that covers all of your body and reaches the ground. It is often worn for ceremonies or in the home.

words.ex: She wore sandals to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着凉鞋去海滩。
words.en: A sandal is a type of light shoe that you wear in warm weather, which has straps that go over your foot and around your ankle.

words.tr:
n. 腰带；彩带；肩带；窗框
v. 系上腰带；装以窗框
words.ex: She wore a red sash around her waist.
words.ex_cn: 她腰上系着一条红色的丝带。
words.en: A sash is a long piece of cloth which people wear around their waist or over one shoulder, especially as part of a uniform or official dress. It can also refer to the frame of a window.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: She wears a warm shawl in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她冬天穿一条暖和的披肩。
words.en: A shawl is a piece of fabric worn by women over the shoulders or head or wrapped around a baby.

words.tr:
n. 寿衣；裹尸布；覆盖物
v. 覆盖；遮蔽
words.ex: The body was wrapped in a white shroud.
words.ex_cn: 遗体被裹在一件白色的寿衣里。
words.en: A shroud is a cloth which is used for wrapping a dead body. It can also refer to something that covers, hides, or protects.

words.tr:
n. 晒成棕褐色的肤色
adj. 棕褐色的；棕黄色的
v. 将皮肤晒成棕褐色
words.ex: He has a deep tan after spending the week at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩度过一周后，皮肤晒成了深棕色。
words.en: If you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun.

words.tr:
n. 挂毯；织锦；壁毯；绣帷
v. 用壁毡装饰；罩上绣花罩毯
words.ex: The wall has a colorful tapestry.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一幅色彩斑斓的挂毯。
words.en: A tapestry is a large piece of heavy cloth on which colored threads are woven to produce a picture, pattern, or design.

words.ex: He wore a tuxedo to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套晚礼服去参加婚礼。
words.en: A tuxedo is a formal suit that men wear on very formal occasions, especially in the evening. It usually consists of a black jacket and trousers, a white shirt, and a bow tie.

words.ex: The queen wore rich vesture at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 女王在仪式上穿着华丽的服饰。
words.en: Clothing or a covering; something that covers or conceals.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: v. 完成；“do”的过去分词； adj. 已完成的；
words.ex: I done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我完成了我的作业。
words.en: If something is done, it has been completed or finished.

words.ex: She bought a new coiffure for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一个新发型。
words.en: A coiffure is a hairstyle, especially an elaborate one.

words.ex: She wore a stunning décolleté gown to the event.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件令人惊艳的袒胸露肩礼服去参加活动。
words.en: A décolleté dress or top is one that has a low neckline and reveals part of the wearer's chest.

words.ex: The senator wore his toga with pride.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员自豪地穿着他的宽外袍。
words.en: A toga is a loose flowing outer garment worn by the citizens of ancient Rome, made of a single piece of cloth wrapped around the body.

words.ex: The lighthouse is on the cape.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔位于海角上。
words.en: A cape is a sleeveless outer garment that fastens at the neck and hangs over the shoulders and back, or a piece of land jutting into the sea or some other large body of water.

words.ex: She wore a long frock to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条长连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A frock is a dress, especially one that is worn by women or girls.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 膏油

words.tr: v. （烤肉时）润以脂油；狠揍；殴打；大骂；公开责骂
words.ex: She baste the turkey with butter every 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 她每20分钟用黄油给火鸡刷一遍。
words.en: To baste means to sew with long, loose stitches in order to hold something in place temporarily, or to moisten meat or other food while cooking by spooning or brushing liquid over it.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.ex: The kitchen floor is made of linoleum.
words.ex_cn: 厨房的地板是用油毡做的。
words.en: Linoleum is a type of floor covering that is made from a mixture of linseed oil, cork dust, wood flour, and pigments pressed onto a canvas or jute backing.

words.tr: n. 胶布雨衣；马金托什雨衣
words.ex: He wears a mackintosh when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他穿一件雨衣。
words.en: A mackintosh is a coat made from material that does not let rain in, or the material itself.

words.tr: n. 人造黄油；人造奶油
words.ex: He puts margarine on his bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在面包上抹人造黄油。
words.en: Margarine is a yellow substance made from vegetable oil and animal fats that is similar to butter. You spread it on bread or use it for cooking.

words.ex: He wears a poncho when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时他穿一件篷风衣。
words.en: A poncho is a piece of clothing that consists of a large piece of material, usually waterproof, with a hole in the middle for the head.

words.tr: n. 柏油帆布；防水油布
words.ex: He covered the truck with a tarpaulin.
words.ex_cn: 他用防水布盖住了卡车。
words.en: A tarpaulin is a large sheet of strong, flexible, water-resistant or waterproof material, often cloth such as canvas or polyester coated with urethane, or made of plastics such as polyethylene. Tarpaulins often have reinforced grommets at the corners and along the sides to form attachment points for rope, allowing them to be tied down or suspended.

words.tr: adj. 假情假义的；油腔滑调的
words.ex: His unctuous manner made me uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他油腔滑调的态度让我感到不舒服。
words.en: If you describe someone as unctuous, you are critical of them because they seem to be full of praise, kindness, or interest, but in a way that is not sincere.

words.tr: v. 涂油；涂油使之神圣化；指定；选定
words.ex: The priest will anoint the baby with oil.
words.ex_cn: 牧师将用油为婴儿抹油。
words.en: To anoint someone means to put oil or water on a part of their body, usually as part of a religious ceremony.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 工具

words.ex: The conductor waved the baton to start the symphony.
words.ex_cn: 指挥家挥动指挥棒，开始交响乐。
words.en: A baton is a stick that is used by conductors to direct an orchestra or choir, by a relay runner to pass on the race, or by a police officer as a weapon.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.tr:
n. 钩；扣；紧握；紧抱
v. 抱紧；握紧；扣紧
words.ex: The necklace has a gold clasp.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链有一个金色的钩。
words.en: A clasp is a small device that fastens something, or the act of holding someone or something tightly.

words.tr:
n. 抽筋；痉挛；夹钳
v. 束缚；使痉挛；用夹钳夹紧
words.ex: He got a cramp in his leg while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时腿抽筋了。
words.en: A cramp is a sudden, involuntary muscle contraction or over-shortening; while generally temporary and non-damaging, they can cause mild-to-severe pain, and a paralysis-like immobility of the affected muscle.

words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.ex: The auctioneer brought the gavel down with a decisive strike.
words.ex_cn: 拍卖师果断地敲下小木槌。
words.en: A gavel is a small wooden hammer that a person in charge of a meeting or an auction hits against a wooden block to call for attention or order.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.tr:
n. 鱼叉
v. 用鱼叉叉
words.ex: The fisherman threw a harpoon at the whale.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫向鲸鱼投掷了一支鱼叉。
words.en: A harpoon is a long spear-like instrument used in fishing to catch large fish or whales.

words.ex: The ship tied up with a thick hawser.
words.ex_cn: 船用一根粗缆绳系泊。
words.en: A hawser is a thick rope or cable used in mooring or towing a ship.

words.ex: He took the helm of the company after the CEO retired.
words.ex_cn: CEO退休后，他成为了公司的领导人。
words.en: The helm is the wheel or control which is used to steer a ship or boat.

words.tr:
n. 锄头
v. 锄（地）；锄（草）
words.ex: He uses a hoe to dig in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用锄头在花园里翻土。
words.en: A hoe is a gardening tool consisting of a long handle with a flat metal blade at the end, used for breaking up soil and removing weeds.

words.tr:
n. 箍；环；圈
v. 加箍于；围绕
words.ex: The barrel is held together by a wooden hoop.
words.ex_cn: 这个桶由一个木制的箍固定在一起。
words.en: A hoop is a large ring made of wood, metal, or plastic, used in games or as a decoration.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: The child looked through the kaleidoscope and laughed.
words.ex_cn: 孩子透过万花筒看，笑了。
words.en: A kaleidoscope is a toy consisting of a tube containing mirrors and pieces of colored glass or paper, whose reflections produce changing patterns when the tube is rotated. It can also refer to a constantly changing pattern or sequence of elements.

words.tr:
n. 车床
v. 用车床加工
words.ex: He uses a lathe to shape wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用车床加工木材。
words.en: A lathe is a machine tool that rotates a workpiece about an axis of rotation to perform various operations such as cutting, sanding, knurling, drilling, or deformation with tools that are applied to the workpiece to create an object with symmetry about that axis.

words.ex: He hit the nail with a wooden mallet.
words.ex_cn: 他用木槌敲钉子。
words.en: A mallet is a tool resembling a hammer but with a larger head, typically made of wood or rubber, used for striking a surface without causing damage.

words.ex: The nippers played happily in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里开心地玩耍。
words.en: A tool used for cutting or gripping, typically consisting of two pivoted limbs forming a pair of jaws.

words.tr:
n. 杵；碾槌
v. 用槌磨；用杵捣
words.ex: She used a pestle to grind the herbs into a fine powder.
words.ex_cn: 她用杵把草药捣成细粉。
words.en: A pestle is a heavy tool with a rounded end, used for crushing and grinding substances such as spices or drugs, usually in a mortar.

words.ex: He used pincers to pull out the nail.
words.ex_cn: 他用钳子把钉子拔出来。
words.en: Pincers are a tool with two parts that are used for holding or pulling things, especially by squeezing them together.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: He used pliers to fix the broken wire.
words.ex_cn: 他用钳子修理了断掉的电线。
words.en: Pliers are a tool with two handles at one end and two hard, flat, metal parts at the other. Pliers are used to hold small things or to bend and cut wire.

words.ex: He uses a razor to shave every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用剃须刀刮胡子。
words.en: A razor is a tool with a sharp blade or set of blades, used to remove hair from the face or body.

words.ex: The leaf shows simple reticulation.
words.ex_cn: 这片叶子显示出简单的网状脉络。
words.en: A pattern or arrangement of interlacing lines resembling a net.

words.tr: n. 抹刀；调色刀；刮勺；刮铲
words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子翻了煎饼。
words.en: A spatula is a tool with a broad, flat, flexible blade used for mixing, spreading, and lifting materials.

words.ex: He used tongs to pick up the hot bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹子夹起热面包。
words.en: A tool consisting of two movable arms joined at one end, used for picking up and holding things.

words.tr: n. 三叉戟；三叉戟式飞机
words.ex: The statue held a trident in its right hand.
words.ex_cn: 雕像的右手握着一把三叉戟。
words.en: A trident is a three-pronged spear, especially as an attribute of Poseidon (Neptune) or Britannia.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.tr:
v. 猛扭；扭伤；挣脱
n. 扳手；扳钳；（离别的）痛苦
words.ex: He wrenched the door open with all his strength.
words.ex_cn: 他用尽全力猛扭门，把它打开了。
words.en: A wrench is a tool used for gripping and turning nuts, bolts, pipes, etc. It can also refer to a sudden violent twist or pull, or a feeling of sadness or distress caused by separation.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: The child drew a sun with a red crayon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用红色蜡笔画了一个太阳。
words.en: A crayon is a stick of colored wax used for drawing or coloring.

words.ex: The blacksmith hit the metal on the anvil.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在铁砧上敲打金属。
words.en: An anvil is a heavy iron block on which hot metals are shaped by hammering.

words.ex: He uses a trowel to spread cement.
words.ex_cn: 他用泥刀抹水泥。
words.en: A trowel is a small hand tool with a flat, pointed blade, used to apply and smooth mortar or plaster.

words.ex: He used a hatchet to cut wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头砍木头。
words.en: A hatchet is a small axe with a short handle, used for chopping wood.

words.ex: She scissored the paper into two pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她把纸剪成了两半。
words.en: To cut something with scissors.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.tr: n. 螺丝刀；改锥；螺丝起子；伏特加橙汁鸡尾酒
words.ex: He used a screwdriver to tighten the loose screws.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了松动的螺丝。
words.en: A screwdriver is a tool that is used for turning screws. It has a handle and a long metal part that fits into the top of the screw.

words.ex: We walked along the Seine at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着塞纳河散步。
words.en: A seine is a type of fishing net that hangs vertically in the water with its bottom edge held down by weights and its top edge buoyed by floats.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.ex: There was a spike in sales after the advertisement.
words.ex_cn: 广告发布后，销量出现了激增。
words.en: A spike is a thin, pointed piece of metal, wood, or another hard material, or a sudden increase in something.

words.tr:
n. 模版；蜡纸
v. （用模版）印制
words.ex: She used a stencil to create the pattern on the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她使用漏字板在布料上制作图案。
words.en: A stencil is a piece of paper, plastic, or metal which has a design cut out of it. You place the stencil on a surface and paint or spray over it to produce the design on the surface.

words.tr: n. （唱机的）唱针；触笔；手写笔
words.ex: The stylus on the record player needed replacing.
words.ex_cn: 唱片机的唱针需要更换。
words.en: A stylus is a small, pointed tool used for writing, drawing, or engraving. It can also refer to the needle of a record player or a pen used on touchscreen devices.

words.ex: The company changed its tack after the market crash.
words.ex_cn: 公司在市场崩盘后改变了行动方针。
words.en: A tack is a short nail with a broad, flat head, used especially for fastening carpets. As a verb, it can mean to fasten something with tacks or to change the direction of a sailing ship.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 沟、渠、管

words.ex: The ancient Romans built an aqueduct to bring water to the city.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马人建造了一条渡槽来为城市供水。
words.en: An aqueduct is a structure designed to carry water from a remote source to a desired location, often using gravity as the driving force. It is a critical component of urban water supply systems, especially in ancient civilizations.

words.tr: n. 导管；管道；水管；水道
words.ex: The cable is a conduit for electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这根电缆是电的通道。
words.en: A conduit is a channel or pipe for conveying water or other fluid.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.tr:
n. 导管；管道；管子
v. 通过管道输送
words.ex: The air flows through the duct.
words.ex_cn: 空气通过管道流动。
words.en: A duct is a pipe or tube through which liquid or gas flows.

words.tr:
n. 排水沟；阴沟；贫民区
v. 忽明忽暗；摇曳不定
words.ex: The rain water flows down the gutter.
words.ex_cn: 雨水沿着排水沟流下。
words.en: A gutter is a channel at the edge of a road or roof that collects and directs rainwater away.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: The culvert under the road was designed to handle heavy rainwater flow.
words.ex_cn: 道路下的涵洞设计用于处理大雨的排水。
words.en: A culvert is a tunnel carrying a stream or open drain under a road or railway.

words.ex: The pig eats from the wooden trough.
words.ex_cn: 猪从木槽里吃东西。
words.en: A long, narrow open container for animals to eat or drink from; a period of low economic activity.

chapters.name: Word List 17 人造事物 建筑

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: He lives in a small garret above the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在商店上面的一个小阁楼里。
words.en: A garret is a room on the top floor of a house, immediately under the roof.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.tr:
n. 堤坝；排水沟
v. 筑堤；开排水沟
words.ex: The dike was built to prevent flooding.
words.ex_cn: 修建堤坝是为了防止洪水泛滥。
words.en: A dike is a long wall or embankment built to prevent flooding from the sea or a river.

words.ex: The window was covered with a lattice of iron bars.
words.ex_cn: 窗户被铁条格子覆盖。
words.en: A lattice is a structure consisting of strips of wood or metal crossed and fastened together with square or diamond-shaped spaces left between.

words.ex: He turned the loft into a bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他把阁楼改成了卧室。
words.en: A loft is a room or space directly under the roof of a building, used for accommodation or storage.

words.tr: n. 宣礼塔（清真寺的一部分）；尖塔
words.ex: The minaret of the mosque towered above the city.
words.ex_cn: 清真寺的尖塔高耸于城市之上。
words.en: A minaret is a tall, slender tower, typically part of a mosque, with a balcony from which a muezzin calls Muslims to prayer.

words.tr: n. 指示塔；高压电线铁塔
words.ex: The pylon holds up the power lines.
words.ex_cn: 电线杆支撑着输电线路。
words.en: A pylon is a tall structure, especially one that is part of a building or that is used to support something such as a bridge or a road.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: The church's steeple was visible from miles away.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的尖塔在数英里外就能看到。
words.en: A steeple is a tall pointed structure on the top of a building, especially a church.

words.ex: The castle has a small turret on each corner.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡的每个角落都有一个小塔。
words.en: A turret is a small tower on top of a building, especially a castle, or a structure on a military vehicle that can turn around and from which guns are fired.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.tr: n. 帆布篷；雨篷；遮阳篷
words.ex: The awnings provided shade from the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 遮阳篷为人们提供了躲避烈日的阴凉处。
words.en: An awning is a piece of material attached to a building or a frame, which provides shelter from the sun or rain.

words.tr: n. 露天看台；露天座位
words.ex: The fans filled the bleachers to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 球迷们填满了露天看台观看比赛。
words.en: The bleachers are the raised, tiered rows of benches found at sports fields and other venues, where spectators sit to watch the event.

words.ex: She pulled the blinds to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上了窗帘以阻挡阳光。
words.en: Blinds are window coverings made of slats or fabric that can be adjusted to control light and privacy.

words.ex: She sat under a bower of roses.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在一丛玫瑰花形成的凉亭下。
words.en: A bower is a pleasant place in the shade under a tree or a structure in a garden where people can sit and relax.

words.ex: The house had a breezeway connecting the main building to the garage.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有一个连接主楼和车库的有顶通道。
words.en: A breezeway is a covered passageway or corridor that connects two buildings or parts of a building, often open at the sides to allow air to flow through.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: He works in a small cubicle at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室的一个小隔间里工作。
words.en: A cubicle is a small space or compartment that is partitioned off, especially one in which someone works or studies.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: His domicile is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所位于纽约。
words.en: A domicile is the place where a person lives or has their home.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.ex: The only egress from the building was blocked by debris.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物的唯一出口被碎片堵住了。
words.en: Egress refers to the act of going out or exiting from a place.

words.ex: The river overflowed and broke the embankment.
words.ex_cn: 河水泛滥，冲垮了堤坝。
words.en: An embankment is a thick wall of earth that is built to carry a road or railway over an area of low ground, or to prevent water from a river or the sea from flooding an area.

words.tr: n. 售货亭；报刊亭；公用电话亭
words.ex: He bought a ticket from the kiosk.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售票机买了一张票。
words.en: A kiosk is a small open-fronted hut or cubicle from which newspapers, refreshments, tickets, etc., are sold.

words.ex: The artist painted a colorful mural on the school wall.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在学校墙上画了一幅色彩斑斓的壁画。
words.en: A mural is a large painting, typically executed directly on a wall.

words.ex: The window has a broken pane.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有一块碎了的玻璃。
words.en: A pane is a piece of glass that is fitted into a window or door.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: The ground began to subside after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨之后，地面开始下陷。
words.en: If a feeling or noise subsides, it becomes less strong or loud.

words.tr:
n. 棚屋；简陋的小屋
v. 居住
words.ex: He lives in a small shack near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一间小木屋里。
words.en: A shack is a small, simple building, often made of wood or metal, which is not very well built or comfortable.

words.tr: n. 简陋的小屋；水手号子；
words.ex: The fishermen lived in a small shanty by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们住在海边的一间简陋小屋里。
words.en: A shanty is a small, crudely built shack or a sailor's work song.

words.ex: We sat under the arbor to escape the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们坐在树阴下躲避炎热的阳光。
words.en: An arbor is a garden structure on which plants and vines are grown.

words.tr: n. 圆形剧场；竞技场；梯形教室
words.ex: The students watched a play in the old amphitheater.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在旧的圆形剧场里观看了戏剧。
words.en: An amphitheater is a large open area surrounded by rows of seats sloping upwards. Amphitheaters were used in ancient Greece and Rome for public entertainments.

words.tr: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道；游乐中心
words.ex: The old arcade has stone pillars and a tiled roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的拱廊有石柱和瓦片屋顶。
words.en: A covered passage with arches along one or both sides.

words.ex: The dormer windows added character to the old house.
words.ex_cn: 老虎窗为这座老房子增添了特色。
words.en: A dormer is a window that is set vertically in a sloping roof.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: The obelisk stands in the center of the square.
words.ex_cn: 方尖碑矗立在广场中央。
words.en: An obelisk is a tall, four-sided, narrow tapering monument which ends in a pyramid-like shape at the top, originally erected in pairs at the entrances of ancient Egyptian temples.

words.ex: The rafter holds up the roof.
words.ex_cn: 屋椽支撑着屋顶。
words.en: A rafter is one of the long, usually wooden, pieces that support the roof of a building.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.ex: He packed his paraphernalia before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了随身用具。
words.en: The equipment, apparatus, or furnishing used in or necessary for a particular activity.

words.tr:
n. 小齿轮；翼
v. 缚住（双臂）
words.ex: The mechanic replaced the damaged pinion in the gearbox.
words.ex_cn: 机械师更换了变速箱中损坏的小齿轮。
words.en: A pinion is a small gear or the outer part of a bird's wing including the flight feathers.

words.tr:
n. 套索
v. 用套索套捕
words.ex: The cowboy skillfully threw the lariat around the calf's neck.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔熟练地将套索套在小牛的脖子上。
words.en: A lariat is a long, light rope with a loop at one end, used especially by cowboys for catching cattle.

words.tr: n. 圆形建筑；圆形大厅
words.ex: The rotunda at the museum was a popular meeting spot.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆的圆形大厅是一个受欢迎的集合地点。
words.en: A rotunda is a large round room or building, especially one with a dome.

words.ex: The potter fired the clay in a kiln.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把陶土放在窑里烧制。
words.en: A kiln is a type of oven that is used to bake clay and pottery in order to make them hard.

words.ex: The ship took on ballast to stay stable in rough water.
words.ex_cn: 船为了在恶劣水域中保持稳定，装载了压舱物。
words.en: Ballast is heavy material that is carried in a ship or hot-air balloon to make it more stable.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.tr:
adj. 臭虫多的
n. 轻型马车；婴儿车
words.ex: The old cabin is buggy after the summer rain.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧小屋在夏雨后虫子很多。
words.en: A buggy is a small, lightweight vehicle, often open and with four wheels, used for recreation or transportation over rough terrain.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: The clipper sailed fast across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 快速帆船迅速穿越了海洋。
words.en: A clipper is a tool used for cutting or trimming, especially hair, nails, or plants. It can also refer to a fast sailing ship used in the past.

words.ex: The drawbridge was raised to prevent the enemy from crossing.
words.ex_cn: 吊桥被升起，以阻止敌人通过。
words.en: A drawbridge is a bridge that can be pulled up, let down, or drawn aside to permit or prevent access, especially over a moat at the entrance to a castle.

words.ex: The flatcar was loaded with large steel beams.
words.ex_cn: 平板车上装载着大型钢梁。
words.en: A flatcar is a railroad car with a flat platform and no sides or roof, used for carrying heavy or large items.

words.tr: n. 跳板；梯口；座间通道；过道
words.ex: Please move aside to make room for the passengers getting off the gangway.
words.ex_cn: 请让开，为从舷梯下船的乘客腾出空间。
words.en: A gangway is a passage or walkway, especially one that is temporary or removable, such as the one used to board a ship.

words.ex: He rode in a limousine to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他坐豪华轿车去参加婚礼。
words.en: A limousine is a large, luxurious car, especially one driven by a chauffeur and having a partition separating the passengers from the driver.

words.ex: He works on a nautical chart.
words.ex_cn: 他正在使用一张航海图。
words.en: Nautical means relating to ships, sailing, or navigation at sea.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: He rowed the boat with an oar.
words.ex_cn: 他用桨划船。
words.en: An oar is a long pole with a wide, flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat.

words.tr: n. 家具仓库；家具搬运车
words.ex: The removal company used a pantechnicon to transport all the furniture.
words.ex_cn: 搬家公司使用家具搬运车来运输所有的家具。
words.en: A large van or truck used for moving furniture.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.ex: The fisherman walked to the pier to check his nets.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫走到码头去检查他的渔网。
words.en: A pier is a platform sticking out into water, usually the sea, which people walk along or use when getting onto or off boats.

words.ex: The boat docked at the quay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在了码头。
words.en: A quay is a long platform beside the sea or a river where boats can be tied up and loaded or unloaded.

words.ex: He comes from a seafaring family.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个航海世家。
words.en: Seafaring relates to travelling by sea, especially as a job or as a way of life.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The train goes over a long viaduct.
words.ex_cn: 火车驶过一座长长的高架桥。
words.en: A viaduct is a long, high bridge that carries a road or a railway across a valley or a low area.

words.ex: They sailed on a yacht during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在假期乘游艇航行。
words.en: A yacht is a medium-sized sailboat used for racing or cruising.

words.tr: n. 无篷小艇；小舟；救生筏；
words.ex: They rowed the dinghy to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们划着无篷小艇去了岛上。
words.en: A dinghy is a small boat that you sail or row.

words.ex: The amazon flows through many countries in South America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河穿过南美洲的许多国家。
words.en: The Amazon is a major river in South America, and it is also the name of the world's largest rainforest that surrounds the river. Additionally, Amazon is a global technology company focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.

words.tr: n. 输送；运输；财产让与；运输工具
words.ex: The conveyance of goods took three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输花了三天时间。
words.en: The act or process of transporting or carrying something from one place to another.

words.ex: The passengers disembark at the port.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在港口上岸。
words.en: To disembark means to leave a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.tr: n. （15–17世纪使用的）西班牙大帆船
words.ex: The galleon was a symbol of Spain's maritime power.
words.ex_cn: 这艘大型帆船是西班牙海上力量的象征。
words.en: A galleon is a large sailing ship with three or more masts, used especially by the Spanish for war and commerce during the 15th to 17th centuries.

words.ex: The captain ordered the pinnace to be prepared for departure.
words.ex_cn: 船长下令准备让舰载艇出发。
words.en: A pinnace is a small boat, often used as a tender for a larger vessel.

words.tr: n. 锣；钟状物；奖章；纪念章
words.ex: The gong sounded to announce the arrival of the emperor.
words.ex_cn: 锣声响起，宣布皇帝的到来。
words.en: A gong is a large, flat, circular piece of metal that you hit with a hammer to make a sound like a loud, deep bell. Gongs are used in ceremonies and musical performances.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: She shook the tambourine to the rhythm of the music.
words.ex_cn: 她随着音乐的节奏摇动手鼓。
words.en: A tambourine is a musical instrument which you shake or hit with your hand. It consists of a drum skin on a circular frame with pairs of small round pieces of metal all around the edge.

words.ex: She wears a white apron while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她做饭时穿着一件白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A bin is a container that you put rubbish in.

words.ex: The old man walks with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拄着藤杖走路。
words.en: A cane is a long, thin stick that you can use to help you walk, or it is a stick used for punishing people by hitting them. It is also a tall, hard plant like bamboo, from which sugar is made.

words.ex: The tent has a waterproof canopy.
words.ex_cn: 这顶帐篷有一个防水天篷。
words.en: A canopy is a layer of something that spreads out and covers an area, especially the branches and leaves that spread out at the top of trees in a forest.

words.ex: The chandelier hangs above the dining table.
words.ex_cn: 吊灯悬挂在餐桌上方。
words.en: A chandelier is a decorative ceiling-mounted light fixture with branches for several light bulbs or candles.

words.tr: n. 板条箱；箱子；篓；破旧的飞机或汽车；
words.ex: The apples were packed in a wooden crate.
words.ex_cn: 苹果被装在一个木板条箱里。
words.en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing goods.

words.ex: He walks with a crutch after his accident.
words.ex_cn: 他事故后拄着拐杖走路。
words.en: A crutch is a stick with a handle and a part that fits under the arm, which you use to support your body if you are having difficulty in walking because of a foot or leg injury.

words.ex: He inserted earplugs to protect his hearing during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会期间戴上耳塞以保护听力。
words.en: A small piece of soft material that you put into your ear to keep out noise or water.

words.ex: He put the papers in a red folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放进了一个红色的活页夹。
words.en: A folder is a thin piece of cardboard or plastic in which you can keep loose papers.

words.ex: The room was furnished with a large four-poster bed.
words.ex_cn: 房间里摆放着一张大四柱床。
